title: Why Drain Traps Are Essential for Every Fixture
description: Every plumbing fixture connected to a drainage system requires a properly installed drain trap. The primary function of a trap is to retain a small amount of water, creating a reliable liquid seal that prevents sewer gases and harmful bacteria from entering the living space. Without this water barrier, toxic and flammable gases would freely vent indoors. Professional plumbers inspect traps regularly for proper seal depth and check for signs of siphonage or evaporation, especially in infrequently used guest bathrooms or utility sinks. Maintaining an intact trap seal is a fundamental requirement for a healthy, safe building environment.
